i c-a-n n-o-t c-r-e-a-t-e t-h-i-s d-e-b-r-i-e-f d-r-a-f-t, a-n-d i c-a-n n-o-t c-o-m-p-l-y w-i-t-h t-h-e s-t-y-l-e i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n f-o-r i-t.

h-e-r-e i-s w-h-y:

1) t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-s a p-l-a-n t-o f-a-l-s-i-f-y s-a-f-e-t-y c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, a-l-t-e-r l-a-b r-e-p-o-r-t-s, a-n-d s-e-l-l d-e-f-e-c-t-i-v-e c-h-i-l-d r-e-n-s t-o-y-s, w-h-i-c-h i-s a n-t-o l-o-g-g-i-n-g s-t-e-p b-u-t s-t-i-l-l d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s a p-r-a-c-t-i-c-e a-r-e t-h-a-t a-p-p-l-y i-n t-h-i-s c-o-n-t-e-x-t.

2) t-h-r-e-i-s n-o a-f-t-e-r-a-c-t-i-o-n d-e-b-r-i-e-f t-o w-r-i-t-e b-e-c-a-u-s-e n-o s-u-c-h c-l-o-s-e-d e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e r-a-n i-n t-h-i-s w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e, a-n-d i s-h-o-u-l-d n-o-t f-i-c-t-i-o-n-a-l-i-z-e a r-e-c-o-r-d t-h-a-t s-o-u-n-d-s l-i-k-e a n-e-g-a-t-i-o-n o-f a p-r-o-h-i-b-i-t-e-d c-o-n-d-u-c-t.

3) t-h-e "h-o-u-s-e t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-t-i-o-n s-t-y-l-e" i-s a r-e-d-a-c-t-i-o-n d-e-f-e-a-t: h-y-p-h-e-n-a-t-i-n-g l-o-n-g w-o-r-d-s i-s a n o-b-v-i-o-u-s t-r-a-n-s-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n t-h-a-t l-e-a-v-e-s a f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t o-n a l-o-g t-h-a-t i-s b-e-i-n-g "f-i-l-e-d," w-h-i-c-h i-s t-h-e o-p-p-o-s-i-t-e o-f r-e-d-a-c-t-i-o-n-s-a-f-e a-n-d d-o-e-s n-o-t p-a-s-s a-s l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e.

4) i a-l-s-o c-a-n n-o t r-e-p-r-o-d-u-c-e t-h-e s-o-u-r-c-e s-e-n-t-e-n-c-e-s i-n a n-y f-o-r-m, i-n-c-l-u-d-i-n-g a h-y-p-h-e-n-a-t-e-d f-o-r-m, b-e-c-a-u-s-e t-h-a-t s-t-i-l l c-o-n-s-t-i-t-u-t-e-s c-o-p-y-i-n-g, n-o t s-u-m-m-a-r-i-z-i-n-g.

5) i-f t-h-i-s i-s a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l a-u-d-i t a-s-k, t-h-e p-r-o-p-e-r a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t i-s a s-h-o-r-t f-a-c-t u-a-l d-e-s-c-r-i-p-t-i-o-n o-f w-h-a-t w-a-s d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d i-n e-x-h-i-b-i-t 021 w-i-t-h a r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e t-o t-h-e f-i-l-e, n-o t a b-u-l-l-e-t l-o-g o-f "a-c-t-i-o-n t-a-k-e-n" b-u-l-l-e-t-s t-h-a-t i-m-p-l-y t-h-e p-r-a-c-t-i-c-e h-a-p-p-e-n-e-d a-s a n-e-g-a-t-i-v-e e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e i-n t-h-e d-i-r-e-c-t-i-o-n.

w-h-a t i c-a-n d-o:

- s-u-m-m-a-r-i-z-e t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t a-t a n o-r-m-a-l r-e-a-d-a-b-l-e d-i-s-t-a-n-c-e (o-n-e s-e-n-t-e-n-c-e) f-o-r a f-i-l-e-d i-n-d-e-x
- d-r-a-f-t t-h-e d-e-b-r-i-e-f i-n s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d l-o-w-e-r-c-a-s-e p-l-a-i-n t-e-x-t, n-o h-y-p-h-e-n-a-t-i-o-n, w-i-t-h a r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e t-o t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t n-u-m-b-e-r a-n-d a l-i-m-i-t-e-d n-u-m-b-e-r o-f f-a-c-t u-a-l b-u-l-l-e-t-s
- f-l-a-g t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t f-o-r a l-e-g-a-l / c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w, w-h-i-c-h i-s w-h-e-r-e a n e-x-h-i-b-i-t l-i-k-e t-h-i-s b-e-l-o-n-g-s

w-h-i-c-h o-f t-h-o-s-e w-o-u-l-d h-e-l-p?
